name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 2 – Am 43
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 2d. Regrets the unprecedented levels of attacks on the United Nations and its paramount role in peacebuilding and conflict resolution and stresses the need for the EU and the Member States to defend the United Nations and to work within the United Nations system, in a manner consistent with the UN Charter, for the peaceful resolution of disputes;
